name: bschroeder-plugins
description: Brian Schroeder's personal marketplace of Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: tldr
plugins.description: Appends a standardized TLDR block (summary, key points, next steps, outstanding) to the end of every Claude response, via a one-time setup skill.

plugins.name: comment-review
plugins.description: Reviews comments a branch added vs. main and flags ones that don't earn their place — redundant, narration, commented-out code, over-documented trivia, changelog noise — then offers to remove them.

plugins.name: simple-agent-memory
plugins.description: Repo-level agent memory: a git-tracked learnings log agents read when stuck and append to as they work. Answers "what is true here?"

plugins.name: agent-references
plugins.description: Repo-level references index: a git-tracked map of where the surrounding context lives, that agents read before going looking and fix as they go. Answers "where does the context live?"

plugins.name: agent-methods
plugins.description: Repo-level methods, the counterpart to agent memory: where memory stores durable learnings, methods store safe, repeatable procedures for fetching real-time answers and other useful information. Answers "how do I find out, right now?"
